lines.text: The Reubenites and Gadites, with large herds, ask Moses for the land of Jazer and Gilead instead of crossing.
The LORD swore that of the men twenty or older from Egypt, only Caleb and Aaron son of Nun would see the land.
Moses says if every armed man crosses until the land is subdued, they may return; otherwise sin will find them.
Moses gave Gad, Reuben and half of Manasseh the kingdoms of Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Moab.
